benchmark_caveats: Local measurements, one observation per scenario plus deterministic hybrid repeats; no causal speed improvement, safety claim, physical calibration or AWS SLA.
Final performance runs had no concurrent test/build suites. Provisional initial master p95 429.097621 ms is preserved separately.
The original randomly placed flood foci had NONE reference intersections. A separate explicitly synthetic corridor exercises actual MEDIA class weight 1.25.
replanning_ms measures the complete prepare/planning phase including reservations, not isolated per-agent invalidation latency.
Browser time includes request/preparation/render/pause acknowledgement; heap is a snapshot, not a leak test.

aws.observability: JSON stdout lab_metrics every 30 seconds, existing log-driver pattern and unapplied Logs Insights templates; no new custom metrics/alarms/OTel.
future_deployment_requirements: persistent writable cache mount if running in read-only container
backup/retention decision; existing root DeleteOnTermination remains true

limitations: Experimental categorical susceptibility weights, no hydrological forecast, DEM, real drainage, water depth or emergency navigation.
Historical event collection and N/A closures never imply an active emergency or create road closures.
Publication/polygon update date and explicit reuse license were not declared; portal modification date is distinct.
Geometries generalized, queried by bbox and retained whole; absence of intersection is not low risk or safety.
SHA-256 validates local integrity, not an institutional signature; source terms/schema may change.
One local lab run per Manager; no remote operator identity, no full historical cache archive, no HA/backups.
Draft/GPS limitations of 4C remain: session draft only, no new physical GPS test.
Earthquake and tsunami adapters are recommendations, not implemented scenarios.
